collection.title: Bentley Mulsanne 2010 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Mulsanne 2010 to 2020 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
